variants.headline: Party walks out of government
variants.body: A party has walked out of the government in {colony}. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: A governing partnership breaks
variants.body: A governing party has left the colony's government. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: Departure redraws the question of cooperation
variants.body: The government has lost a party from its governing arrangement. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.
